name: Engelmann's hedgehog cactus
desc: Engelmann's hedgehog cactus (Echinocereus engelmannii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 92 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Echinocereus engelmannii, the strawberry hedgehog cactus or Engelmann's hedgehog cactus, is a cactus commonly found in desert areas of the southwestern United States and the adjacent areas of Mexico,…
